faq_q1: Is Scalyo right for my team size?
faq_a1: Yes. Scalyo is built for CS teams from 1 to 50 CSMs. Starter fits solo CSMs. Growth handles up to 10 CSMs. Elite is designed for larger teams with advanced management needs.
faq_a2: Scalyo runs on Supabase (encrypted PostgreSQL) and Cloudflare. Data is isolated per company via Row Level Security. No data is shared between accounts. Hosted in Europe.
faq_a3: Yes, upgrade or downgrade from settings. Changes take effect immediately, with no fees or commitment.
faq_q4: How does the AI CS Coach work?
faq_a4: The AI CS Coach specializes in Customer Success, trained on B2B SaaS best practices: NRR, churn, QBR, expansion. Powered by DeepSeek — no setup required.
faq_a5: No. Scalyo is month-to-month with no commitment. Cancel anytime from your account, with no fees or delays.
faq_a6: Yes, support is available in English and French. Contact us at support@scalyo.app. Elite clients also get a monthly coaching session.
faq_a7: No. Scalyo complements your CRM (Salesforce, HubSpot, Pipedrive). Where your CRM handles the sales pipeline, Scalyo focuses on retention and post-sale relationships.
faq_a8: After your trial, choose the plan that fits your team. Your data is fully preserved, whatever you decide.
